goal: Deepen the active-task Task Rail with an Assurance phase row and a bounded QA acceptance-progress row fed only from existing foreground update payloads, and add one /imm-tasks read-only overlay command that lists the active Managed task and every not-enrolled docs/plans/*.intent.json draft (settled history excluded) without mutating any authority state.

acceptance.assertion: The Task Rail renders an optional Assurance phase row and an optional QA acceptance-progress row (n/total + latest acceptance_id with running/passed/failed) when the view carries those fields, and renders exactly the previous three rows when they are absent, proven by focused extension tests on renderTaskRail outputs.

A /imm-tasks read-only overlay lists the active task with its projected Obligation and Rail state plus every not-enrolled docs/plans/*.intent.json draft shown as Planning, excludes settled history, performs no authority mutation, and closes without state change, proven by focused extension tests using the existing makeCtx/makeUI harness.

Every touched .pi-extension source file keeps the Footer empty and stays free of setStatus-with-text, timers, polling, and sound emission, proven by the existing forbidden-source scan assertions extended over the changed files.

The candidate Spec docs/specs/task-rail-progress-depth-and-overview.spec.md exists with Design risk, Diagram decision, and Diagram reason fields and maps every Brainstorm manifest ID in its Brainstorm Trace, proven by a focused spec-presence test.
